name.en: DOB final inspection and Certificate of Occupancy (or Letter of No Objection)
name.zh: 建筑局（DOB）最终验收及入住证（或无异议函）

when.en: After construction and all trade sign-offs, before anyone occupies the space. A CO is needed for a new building or a change in use, egress or occupancy; minor alterations get a Letter of Completion; pre-1938 buildings with no CO can use a Letter of No Objection.
when.zh: 施工及各专业验收完成后、正式使用前。新建筑或用途、疏散、占用类型变更需要入住证（CO）；小型改造发完工函；1938年前建成且没有CO的建筑可申请无异议函（LNO）。

book.en: Your applicant of record requests the inspection (for a CO job, "Construction Inspection Sign Off Prior to Occupancy") in DOB NOW: Inspections, then submits the Certificate of Occupancy Request in DOB NOW: Build. An LNO is requested from the DOB borough office with the LNO/LOV application.
book.zh: 由备案申请人在 DOB NOW: Inspections 预约验收（CO 项目选“入住前施工验收签核”），再在 DOB NOW: Build 提交入住证申请。无异议函需用 LNO/LOV 申请表向所在区的 DOB 办公室申请。

lead.en: DOB says LNO requests take about three weeks.
lead.zh: DOB 表示无异议函申请约需三周。

feeNote.en: No fee published for the final inspection itself. A Letter of No Objection costs $130 for commercial buildings.
feeNote.zh: 最终验收本身未公布收费。商业建筑的无异议函费用为 130 美元。

failNext.en: Outstanding objections are listed on the job in DOB NOW and must be resolved before the sign-off can proceed. No CO or LNO is issued while any application or violation is open.
failNext.zh: 未解决的问题会在 DOB NOW 的项目中列出，必须处理完毕才能签核。只要有未结的申请或违规，就不会签发 CO 或 LNO。

item.en: Final construction inspection signed off
item.zh: 最终施工验收已签核

item.en: Final plumbing inspection signed off
item.zh: 最终管道验收已签核

item.en: Final electrical inspection signed off
item.zh: 最终电气验收已签核

item.en: All required special inspection reports submitted by the special inspection agency
item.zh: 所有要求的专项检查报告已由专项检查机构提交

item.en: As-built drawings submitted for non-substantive changes; substantive changes filed as a PAA
item.zh: 非实质性变更已提交竣工图；实质性变更已提交修改申请（PAA）

item.en: No open applications and no open violations on the property
item.zh: 该物业没有未结的申请和违规记录

item.en: Owner's Cost Affidavit (PW3) filed
item.zh: 已提交业主成本声明（PW3）

item.en: Schedule of Occupancy approved in DOB NOW: Build
item.zh: DOB NOW: Build 中的占用明细表（Schedule of Occupancy）已获批准

item.en: For an LNO: the restaurant or store is in the same Use Group and Occupancy Group as the legal use, with occupant load and egress substantially unchanged
item.zh: 申请 LNO 时：餐厅或店铺与合法用途属于同一用途组和占用组，人数荷载和疏散基本不变

why.en: A change of Use or Occupancy Group needs an ALT-1 and a new CO (AC 28-118.3.4)
why.zh: 改变用途组或占用组需提交 ALT-1 并申请新的 CO（AC 28-118.3.4）

name.en: FDNY Rangehood Unit preliminary inspection and suppression acceptance test
name.zh: 消防局（FDNY）排烟罩组首次检查及灭火系统验收测试

agency.en: FDNY Bureau of Fire Prevention, Rangehood Unit
agency.zh: 纽约市消防局防火处排烟罩组

when.en: After the hood, exhaust and fire-extinguishing system are installed under DOB approval, before you cook. Passing leads to the annual FDNY commercial cooking permit.
when.zh: 排烟罩、排风系统和灭火系统经 DOB 批准安装完成后、开火营业前。通过后 FDNY 会签发年度商用烹饪系统许可。

book.en: Request the inspection or test on the FDNY Business website (NYC.ID account required). Cancellations and reschedules also go through FDNY Business.
book.zh: 在 FDNY Business 网站预约检查或测试（需要 NYC.ID 账户）。取消和改期也在该网站办理。

feeNote.en: Acceptance test $285 (mechanical only) or $580 (mechanical and electrical); plan review $210; document management $165; permit $70 per system.
feeNote.zh: 验收测试 285 美元（仅机械）或 580 美元（机械加电气）；图纸审查 210 美元；文件管理费 165 美元；许可费每套系统 70 美元。

failNext.en: No permit is issued until the system complies with the approved plans; you must correct the defects and request another test.
failNext.zh: 系统符合批准图纸之前不会发许可，需整改后重新预约测试。

item.en: Exhaust and fire-extinguishing system match the approved plans, code and manufacturer's specifications
item.zh: 排风和灭火系统与批准图纸、规范及厂家说明一致

item.en: Fire-extinguishing system installed by a DOB-licensed Class A or C master fire suppression piping contractor
item.zh: 灭火系统由 DOB 持牌的 A 类或 C 类消防管道总承包商安装

item.en: System activates automatically and shuts off gas or power to the cooking appliances; a manual pull device is installed
item.zh: 系统能自动启动并切断烹饪设备的燃气或电源；装有手动拉启装置

item.en: Nozzles have their caps and point over the designated cooking equipment
item.zh: 喷头带有防护帽，并对准指定的烹饪设备

item.en: Canopy hood fitted with baffle-type grease filters
item.zh: 罩式排烟罩装有挡板式油脂过滤网

item.en: At least one Class K portable extinguisher within 30 feet of the cooking equipment
item.zh: 烹饪设备 30 英尺内至少有一个 K 类手提灭火器

item.en: Placard posted: "the fire extinguishing system must be activated prior to using a portable fire extinguisher", with manual-operation instructions under glass or laminated near the pull station
item.zh: 张贴“使用手提灭火器前必须先启动灭火系统”标识，手动操作说明需加玻璃或塑封，贴在手动拉启装置附近

item.en: Duct schematic and cleaning and operating instructions posted
item.zh: 张贴风管示意图及清洁、操作说明

item.en: Valid service tag from the master fire suppression piping contractor on the system
item.zh: 系统上挂有消防管道总承包商出具的有效检修标签

item.en: Kitchen staff trained to activate the system manually and use the extinguishers; training records kept
item.zh: 厨房员工已接受手动启动系统和使用灭火器的培训，并保存培训记录

name.zh: 卫生局（DOHMH）发证前（开业前）检查

agency.en: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH), Bureau of Food Safety and Community Sanitation
agency.zh: 纽约市卫生和心理卫生局（DOHMH）食品安全与社区卫生处

when.en: After you apply for the Food Service Establishment permit. You may operate 22 days after applying even without it; to open sooner, request a pre-operating inspection. Otherwise the inspector visits unannounced after you open.
when.zh: 提交餐饮服务场所许可申请之后。即使未检查，申请满 22 天后也可营业；想更早开业可预约开业前检查。否则检查员会在开业后不预先通知上门。

book.en: Call 212-676-1600 to schedule a pre-operating inspection.
book.zh: 致电 212-676-1600 预约开业前检查。

feeNote.en: No separate fee is published for this inspection. The Food Service Establishment permit is $280 a year for most restaurants (plus $25 if you make frozen desserts).
feeNote.zh: 该检查未公布单独收费。大多数餐厅的餐饮服务场所许可费为每年 280 美元（制作冷冻甜品另加 25 美元）。

scoring.en: Not graded: inspections of new restaurants not yet open to the public are scored but get no letter grade.
scoring.zh: 不评等级：尚未对公众开放的新餐厅的检查只计分，不发字母等级。

failNext.en: The inspector gives you a list of things to fix and you must schedule another inspection. If you pass, the permit is mailed to you.
failNext.zh: 检查员会给出整改清单，须重新预约检查。通过后许可证会邮寄给你。

item.en: A supervisor holding a Food Protection Certificate is on duty whenever food is received or prepared or the restaurant is open
item.zh: 接收或加工食品及营业期间，都有持食品保护证书（FPC）的主管在岗

item.en: Hot and cold holding equipment works; thermometers available to check food temperatures
item.zh: 冷热保温设备正常运转；备有温度计检测食品温度

item.en: Cracks, crevices and holes in walls, cabinets and doors sealed against rodents, cockroaches and flies
item.zh: 墙面、柜体和门上的裂缝、缝隙和孔洞已封堵，防鼠、防蟑螂、防蝇

item.en: Rodent-proof door sweeps on outside doors
item.zh: 外门装有防鼠门底刷

item.en: Food and garbage stored in pest-proof containers
item.zh: 食品和垃圾存放在防虫鼠的容器中

item.en: Contract with a pest control professional licensed to work in restaurants
item.zh: 已与持牌、可服务餐厅的虫害防治公司签约

item.en: Food-contact and non-food surfaces smooth and cleanable; deeply grooved cutting boards and chipped surfaces replaced
item.zh: 食品接触面和非接触面平滑易清洁；深划痕砧板和破损表面已更换

item.en: Plumbing fitted with approved backflow devices (valves, anti-siphon pieces, vacuum breakers)
item.zh: 管道装有合格的防回流装置（阀门、防虹吸件、真空破坏器）

item.en: Grease traps clean and maintained
item.zh: 隔油池清洁并保养良好

item.en: Range hoods clean and grease-free
item.zh: 排烟罩清洁、无油污

name.en: FDNY Place of Assembly inspection (75+ occupants)
name.zh: FDNY 集会场所检查（75 人以上）

agency.en: FDNY Bureau of Fire Prevention, Public Assembly Unit (after DOB issues the PA Certificate of Operation)
agency.zh: 纽约市消防局防火处公共集会组（在 DOB 签发集会场所运营证之后）

when.en: Only if 75 or more people (staff included) can gather indoors, or 200 or more outdoors. DOB does the initial inspection for the PA Certificate of Operation; an FDNY inspector then visits within a few months for the first annual inspection and issues the Place of Assembly Permit, renewed yearly.
when.zh: 仅适用于室内可容纳 75 人以上（含员工）或室外 200 人以上的场所。集会场所运营证的首次检查由 DOB 负责；之后数月内 FDNY 检查员会进行首次年检并签发集会场所许可，每年续期。

book.en: Apply for the PA Certificate of Operation in DOB NOW: Build. The FDNY Public Assembly Unit then schedules the annual inspection; questions go to FDNY Business by 311 or FDNY.BusinessSupport@FDNY.nyc.gov.
book.zh: 先在 DOB NOW: Build 申请集会场所运营证，之后由 FDNY 公共集会组安排年检；咨询可拨 311 或发邮件至 FDNY.BusinessSupport@FDNY.nyc.gov。

feeNote.en: The annual inspection fee is on a sliding scale by occupancy; re-inspections are billed at $210 an hour.
feeNote.zh: 年检费按可容纳人数分级收取；复查按每小时 210 美元计费。

failNext.en: Violations are issued and FDNY re-inspects at $210 an hour; the permit is renewed based on the annual inspection results.
failNext.zh: 会开出违规通知，FDNY 复查按每小时 210 美元收费；许可是否续期取决于年检结果。

item.en: Approved DOB plans and the PA Certificate of Operation on site; actual layout matches the plans
item.zh: 现场备有 DOB 批准图纸和集会场所运营证，实际布局与图纸一致

item.en: Capacity sign, permits and Certificate of Occupancy posted
item.zh: 张贴最大容纳人数标识、各项许可和入住证

item.en: Number of people never exceeds the posted capacity
item.zh: 现场人数从不超过张贴的容量

item.en: Exits unblocked, unlocked and marked; aisles and hallways clear
item.zh: 出口畅通、未上锁且有标识；过道和走廊无阻挡

item.en: Emergency lighting and exit signs in working order
item.zh: 应急照明和出口指示灯正常工作

item.en: No combustible material or waste stored in corridors
item.zh: 走廊内不存放可燃物或可燃垃圾

item.en: Smoke and fire alarms, sprinklers, standpipes and extinguishers in working order with current inspection and testing
item.zh: 烟雾和火灾报警、喷淋、竖管及灭火器运转正常，检测在有效期内

item.en: Flame-proofing affidavit for curtains, upholstery and similar materials, confirmed by a C-15 holder
item.zh: 备有窗帘、软包等材料的阻燃宣誓书，由 C-15 持证人确认

item.en: Required Certificates of Fitness on site (F-03/F-04 for PA personnel where required; S-12/S-15 or S-95/F-53 if there are sprinklers or a fire alarm panel)
item.zh: 现场有要求的资格证书（需要时的 F-03/F-04 集会场所人员证；有喷淋或报警主机时的 S-12/S-15 或 S-95/F-53）

item.en: Drill logbook kept on the premises for at least three years
item.zh: 演练记录簿在店内保存至少三年

name.en: FDNY annual cooking exhaust and suppression re-inspection
name.zh: FDNY 年度排烟及灭火系统复检

agency.en: FDNY Bureau of Fire Prevention, Rangehood Unit
agency.zh: 纽约市消防局防火处排烟罩组

when.en: Every year, to renew the commercial cooking system permit.
when.zh: 每年一次，用于续期商用烹饪系统许可。

book.en: FDNY conducts the re-inspection annually; manage the permit and any requests on FDNY Business.
book.zh: 由 FDNY 每年进行复检；许可及相关申请在 FDNY Business 办理。

feeNote.zh: FDNY 年度许可，每套系统 70 美元。

failNext.en: Violations are issued; most common failures are unposted permit or sticker, a system different from the permitted installation, and excessive grease.
failNext.zh: 会开出违规通知；最常见的不合格原因是未张贴许可或贴纸、系统与许可安装不一致、油脂积聚过多。

item.en: FDNY commercial cooking permit posted
item.zh: 张贴 FDNY 商用烹饪许可

item.en: Unexpired FDNY-approved hood cleaning company decal on the hood
item.zh: 排烟罩上贴有未过期的 FDNY 认可清洁公司贴纸

item.en: Exhaust system cleaned by an FDNY-approved company at least every 3 months; receipt and time-stamped before/after photos kept
item.zh: 排风系统至少每 3 个月由 FDNY 认可公司清洁一次；保留收据和带时间戳的前后对比照片

item.en: Grease filters inspected daily, cleaned at least monthly, grease under 1/8 inch; filter cleaning records kept
item.zh: 油脂过滤网每日检查、至少每月清洗，积油厚度不超过 1/8 英寸；保留清洗记录

item.en: Suppression system inspected, tested and serviced by a licensed master fire suppression piping contractor at least every 6 months; valid tag and written report
item.zh: 灭火系统至少每 6 个月由持牌消防管道总承包商检查、测试和维护；有有效标签和书面报告

item.en: Portable extinguishers checked monthly (tag dated and initialed) and serviced yearly by an FDNY-approved company
item.zh: 手提灭火器每月检查（标签注明日期并签名），每年由 FDNY 认可公司维护

item.en: No unapproved changes to the cooking line since the permitted installation
item.zh: 自许可安装以来，烹饪线没有未经批准的改动

item.en: Staff retrained on manual activation of the suppression system at least every 6 months
item.zh: 至少每 6 个月对员工重新培训手动启动灭火系统

name.en: DOHMH graded sanitary inspection (initial and re-inspection)
name.zh: DOHMH 卫生评级检查（首检及复检）

agency.en: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH)
agency.zh: 纽约市卫生和心理卫生局（DOHMH）

when.en: Unannounced, at least once a year. If the initial inspection scores 14 or more, an unannounced re-inspection follows, typically within a month. Next cycle: 11–13 months after an A, 5–7 months if the initial scored 14–27, 3–5 months if 28+.
when.zh: 不预先通知，每年至少一次。首检得分 14 分及以上，通常一个月内会不预先通知复检。下一轮：拿到 A 后 11–13 个月；首检 14–27 分则 5–7 个月；28 分以上则 3–5 个月。

book.en: Not booked; the Health Department arrives unannounced. You can request an ungraded consultative inspection (call 212-676-1600 or check Question 10 on the permit application).
book.zh: 无需预约，卫生局不预先通知上门。可申请不评级的咨询性检查（致电 212-676-1600，或在许可申请表第 10 题勾选）。

feeNote.en: No inspection fee. Optional consultative inspections cost $100 (before your first grade) or $400 (after). No fines for violations on an inspection that results in an A.
feeNote.zh: 检查本身不收费。可选的咨询性检查费用为 100 美元（首次评级前）或 400 美元（评级后）。得 A 的检查不对违规罚款。

scoring.en: Points per violation; lower is better. 0–13 = A, 14–27 = B, 28+ = C. An A on the initial inspection is posted at once; otherwise the re-inspection is graded. Post the grade (or Grade Pending) card on a front window, door or outside wall within 5 feet of the entrance, 4–6 feet off the ground.
scoring.zh: 按违规扣分，分数越低越好。0–13 分为 A，14–27 分为 B，28 分以上为 C。首检得 A 立即张贴；否则以复检结果评级。等级卡（或“评级待定”卡）须贴在前窗、门或外墙上，距入口 5 英尺以内、离地 4–6 英尺。

failNext.en: A B or C on re-inspection gets a grade card and a Grade Pending card; you may post either until your OATH hearing. Very poor re-inspections lead to monthly monitoring inspections until the score is under 28. A public health hazard not fixed on the spot can close the restaurant. Not posting the card: fines up to $1,000.
failNext.zh: 复检得 B 或 C 会拿到等级卡和“评级待定”卡，在 OATH 听证前可任选其一张贴。复检很差会每月监控检查，直到低于 28 分。当场无法纠正的公共卫生危害可导致停业。不张贴等级卡最高罚款 1,000 美元。

item.en: Hot and cold food held at the right temperatures; thermometers used to monitor stored food
item.zh: 热食和冷食保持在规定温度；用温度计监测储存食品温度

item.en: Food held out of temperature control is labeled with removal temperature, removal time and discard time (4 hours; 6 hours for cold food with tracking)
item.zh: 脱离温控的食品贴有取出时温度、取出时间和丢弃时间标签（4 小时；冷食加温度跟踪可 6 小时）

why.zh: 《卫生法典》第 81 条“以时间作为公共卫生控制”规定

item.en: Food covered until served; raw items such as poultry separated from ready-to-eat food
item.zh: 食品上桌前加盖；生禽等生食与即食食品分开

item.en: Food-prep surfaces cleaned and sanitized after each use; no caked-on food
item.zh: 食品加工台面每次使用后清洁消毒；无结块残渣

item.en: Food Protection Certificate holder supervising whenever the restaurant prepares food or is open
item.zh: 加工食品或营业期间有食品保护证书持有人监督

item.en: No evidence of mice, rats, roaches or flies; openings sealed and door sweeps intact
item.zh: 无老鼠、蟑螂或苍蝇迹象；缝隙已封堵，门底刷完好

item.en: Plumbing fixtures working, with backflow devices in place
item.zh: 管道设施运转正常，防回流装置齐全

item.en: Grease and food particles cleaned from equipment and the floor beneath; range hoods grease-free
item.zh: 设备及其下方地面无油污和食物残渣；排烟罩无油污

item.en: Current grade card (the original, not a copy) posted in the required spot
item.zh: 当前等级卡（须为原件，不能是复印件）张贴在规定位置
